item.description:

  • 発売日: 2002-01-18
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 学校に行こう！！－lose one’s heart－
  • 英語名: Gakkou ni Ikou!! -Lose One’s Heart-

あらすじ

Main character works for a personal computer division at work, but there are only enough devices for one third of workers, so protagonist is sent to the school with personal computers. He needs to prepare for qualification tests or he’s going to be fired. It’s a nice time to go to school again!

item.description:

  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: レビューオフ Brind Summer Vacation
  • 英語名: Review of Brind Summer Vacation

别名

  • レビューオフ ～Brind Summer Vacation～

あらすじ

Main character is an upcoming manga writer with one magical girl story to receive anime adaptation. He organizes a party to meet offline with the fans. Thirteen people have gathered, but even though nicknames are known, noone knows each others faces. What will come out of this party?
